knowledge_graph.title: 咖啡 (Coffee)
knowledge_graph.description: 咖啡是指将咖啡植物的种子经过烘焙磨粉后冲泡溶解制成的饮料。咖啡是世界上流行范围最为广泛的软性饮料之一，因其有效成分咖啡因是一种中枢神经兴奋剂，人类通常会为了提神或社交等原因饮用。

related_questions.snippet: The latest research supports the conclusion that for most adults, consuming up to 400 mg of caffeine/day (or up to 5, 8-ounce cups of caffeinated coffee per day) is safe and appears to be linked to a lower risk of cardiovascular disease for some individuals.

related_questions.question: Is coffee from China good?
related_questions.snippet: A fine cup of China coffee displays a light to medium body with a relatively mild acidity and clean taste. Some have compared China coffee to wet-processed South American coffees.

related_questions.question: What are the benefits of coffee?
related_questions.snippet: Drinking coffee with caffeine has been linked with improved mood and a lower risk of depression in some groups. Drinking 3 to 4 cups of coffee a day is linked to a lower risk of stroke in some studies. And coffee may help protect against cancers of the mouth, throat and digestive system.
